# load the data
cases, deaths = get_country_data("US", "Northern Mariana Islands")

# get population of the region for future normalisation:
inhabitants = population(country="US", region="Northern Mariana Islands")
print(f'Population of country="US", region="Northern Mariana Islands": {inhabitants} people')

# compose into one table
table = compose_dataframe_summary(cases, deaths)

# show tables with up to 1000 rows
pd.set_option("max_rows", 1000)

# display the table
table

  • Atlo Team for gathering and providing data from Hungary (https://atlo.team/koronamonitor/)
  • Open source and scientific computing community for the data tools
  • Github for hosting repository and html files
  • Project Jupyter for the Notebook and binder service
  • The H2020 project Photon and Neutron Open Science Cloud (PaNOSC)
